body:
Projects and the card Board now run on one board component with one card style, in 7d0a503 and running in the existing HTTPS app. Project cards no longer show initials, a handle or a separate move menu; one quiet actions menu keeps status moves and deletion.

The board's movement was reviewed and rebuilt: the preview lifts, leans and lands, cards part around a slot, a move is shown at once and saves without a dialog, phone columns are snap pages, a collapsed column opens under a held card, and Alt+Left/Right moves a card one column over.

Smoke and 40 of 41 Chromium suites pass. The one failing suite check, one unit failure and a 45-byte bundle overage come from the add-menu work already on main. Touch feel on a physical phone was not checked; that and acceptance are the owner's. Evidence: progress/2026-10-07-shared-board-engine.md, decision: docs/ADR-071-SHARED-BOARD-ENGINE.md.

metadata.summary: One board engine for Projects and cards, with rebuilt movement
